name: npp_uf_update
desc: Real npp connected-components kernel labelMarkersUFUpdate(unsigned int* labels, unsigned int n, NppiSize) from libnpp sm_90 npp_uf.cubin, lifted to x86 and run on CPU. Union-find path-flatten: each node follows labels[x] until a self-pointing root, then writes labels[gid]=root. The final state is ORDER-INDEPENDENT (compressing a node to its root never changes any root), so the wrapper's sequential-CTA execution matches a host reference computed from the ORIGINAL forest. Params: labels@0x210, n@0x218 (NppiSize unused). Verified with a forest of 20 distinct roots and chains up to depth 9 (a degenerate 'write 0' kernel would fail).
